titles.romaji: Kindaichi Shounen no Jikenbo: Shinigami Byouin Satsujin Jiken
titles.native: 金田一少年の事件簿 SP「死神病院殺人事件」

description:
A one-hour special that aired after a month of the series' absence on television between episodes 23 and 24.

Kindaichi will have to investigate in a hospital where series of murder happen.
